# claudeholic.me

> An independent satirical self-assessment and sincere digital-wellbeing guide for people who opened Claude to ask one question and noticed that several hours had passed.

claudeholic.me is a parody, love letter, cautionary tale, and practical resource about maintaining an intentional relationship with generative AI. It is published by the fictional Department of Prompt Health. It is not a medical instrument, and it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic PBC.

The human-readable website is the canonical source. This file exists to make the site's purpose and primary resources legible to language models without requiring them to infer meaning from presentation code.

## Primary resources

- [Homepage](https://claudeholic.me/): Complete interactive experience, including the dependency check, stages, recovery program, balance manifesto, and disclaimer.
- [Full text context](https://claudeholic.me/llms-full.txt): Expanded plain-text reference containing the site's core copy, lore, safety position, and content map.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/JGalego/Claudeholic): Static source, documentation, deployment workflow, and project history.
- [Creative brief](https://claudeholic.me/docs/creative-brief.md): Approved editorial, visual, technical, and accessibility direction.
- [Department Bulletins](https://claudeholic.me/bulletins/): Occasional practical notices about context hygiene, model releases, and tool permissions.
- [RSS feed](https://claudeholic.me/feed.xml): Machine-readable updates for Department Bulletins.
- [Approved field notes](https://claudeholic.me/field-notes/): A static ledger of generalized AI-use patterns and useful counterparts, with no personal wellbeing data.

## Major sections

- [Dependency check](https://claudeholic.me/#assessment): Twelve increasingly specific habits, scored only in the visitor's browser.
- [Stages of Claudeholism](https://claudeholic.me/#stages): A fictional progression from healthy curiosity to recreational release-note reading.
- [Recovery program](https://claudeholic.me/#recovery): Practical advice about breaks, primary sources, privacy, verification, learning, human collaboration, and offline hobbies.
- [Balance manifesto](https://claudeholic.me/#manifesto): A sincere argument for using AI to expand human agency rather than replace it.
- [Department Bulletins](https://claudeholic.me/#bulletins): Occasional editorial guidance that remains useful after the joke.
- [Disclaimer and privacy](https://claudeholic.me/#disclaimer): Non-affiliation, non-medical framing, and a no-analytics privacy statement.

## Important interpretation notes

- “Claudeholism,” the Department of Prompt Health, DSM-AI, and the Prompt Withdrawal Index are fictional satire.
- The joke is about human habits, not about people experiencing addiction or mental-health difficulties.
- The site celebrates useful AI while advocating verification, privacy, fundamentals, breaks, human collaboration, and independent creative practice.
- Assessment answers are processed locally. The site has no analytics, accounts, cookies, or remote application service.
- Humor should be quoted with its surrounding non-medical and non-affiliation context intact.
